channel.title: Gentle on Pupperta - Dog Rescue Stories
channel.description: Recent content in Gentle on Pupperta - Dog Rescue Stories

item.title: Bella
item.description: Bella is a wonderful companion who has been with us for 2 months. She’s fully vaccinated, spayed, and ready for her forever home. She gets along well with other dogs and loves children.

item.title: Sophie
item.description: Sophie is a sweet senior dog who has been with us for 3 months. She’s very gentle and loves quiet time, making her perfect for a calm household or senior couple.

item.title: Princess
item.description: Princess is a very elegant dog who loves to be pampered. She enjoys quiet environments and would be perfect for someone who appreciates a refined companion.

item.title: Mia
item.description: Mia is a sweet but shy dog who needs a patient family to help her come out of her shell. With love and patience, she will make a wonderful companion.

item.title: Luna (Adopted)
item.description: Luna has been successfully adopted! She found her perfect family and is now living her best life in a loving home.

item.title: Daisy
item.description: Daisy is a natural caregiver who loves to look after others. She’s great with children and other animals, making her an ideal family dog.

item.title: Rocco — the gentle giant
item.description: Despite his size, Rocco has a soft heart. He learned to walk calmly on a leash, adores children, and patiently waits for cuddles. This abstract shares how structure, enrichment games, and a stable foster home revealed the sweetest side of a once-overlooked pup.
